footer.label: Jiɔk gɔ̈ɔ̈r
footer.mission: New Roots a luäk ji ŋɔak kɛnɛ ji ŋäc ŋɔak kɛ kuic ɛ ɣɔ ɛ̈ kä nhiam ba duel kɛ̈ɛ̈l gɔr kä Melbourne.
footer.country1: New Roots a ŋäc nath Bunurong, Wurundjeri Woi-wurrung kɛnɛ Wadawurrung ti ɛ Kulin Nation, ji mun Melbourne ɛn walɛ.
footer.country2: Kɔn ŋäc kä ca ke tɛ̈th kɛ mun, pi̱ kɛnɛ nath, kɛnɛ jɛ mun ken kuɔ̈ɔ̈th ɛ thilɛ ran ca jɛ ŋun. Kɔn thek ji dïït ken walɛ kɛnɛ ɛmɔ, kɛnɛ nath Aboriginal kɛnɛ Torres Strait Islander diaal.
footer.experience: Kɔn ŋäc nath ŋɔak kɛnɛ ji ŋäc ŋɔak ti ca duɔɔl ti pay yɔ̈k kä Victoria, kɛnɛ nath ti loor ke. New Roots ca jɛ la̱t kɛ wël kä ca ke nɛn mi gɔr kɛ duel.
footer.emergency: Mi tɛ ɛ ruac in rac, cɔl {number}.
footer.legal: © {year} New Roots, Team C. Lat gaat thukul kä Monash University ITO5002, kɛnɛ thilɛ kä kume. Namba ɛ bɛ̈ kä wël kume ti liep, kɛnɛ cäŋ ken ɛ tɛ̈ kɛ ke. Namba luäk ɛ thuɔ̱ɔ̱ŋ.
footer.updated: Wël ca ke la̱t kä pay {date}.
footer.wcag: Ca jɛ la̱t ba WCAG 2.2 level AA yɔ̈k.

intro.title: Ji ca bɛ̈ kɛ mi gɔa
intro.heading: Yɔ̈k cieŋ kä Melbourne ti lɔ̈ɔ̈ di rent ken
intro.lead: New Roots ɛ kɛ ji ŋɔak kɛnɛ ji ŋäc ŋɔak ti gɔr duel kɛ̈ɛ̈l kä Melbourne in Diit. Bɛ̈r thieec ti ŋuan ti ŋuɔt, kɛnɛ kɔn bä cieŋ ti thiäk kɛ yiëëu du kɛnɛ ji cieŋ du nyuth.

howItWorks.title: Kä la̱t New Roots
howItWorks.lead: Kä kuen kɔn yiëëu du, kä guir kɔn cieŋ, kɛnɛ ɣɔ bɛ̈ namba diaal.
howItWorks.budget1: Rent ti gɔa ɛ 30% yiëëu ji cieŋ ka tot. Ɛmɛ ɛ kä la̱t Victorian Rental Report kɛ jɛ.
howItWorks.budget2: Mi yɔ̈k di yiëëu Centrelink, kɔn kuen yiëëu ran dïït diaal kɛ kä diit diaal, ka yiëëu ti ca di gɔ̈r kɛ Yiëëu kɔ̈k. Commonwealth Rent Assistance kɛnɛ Energy Supplement ɛ kuen kä yiëëu du.
howItWorks.budget3: Mi yɔ̈k di yiëëu lat kɛ rɔ, kɔn la̱t kɛ 30% kɛnɛ kɔn ci̱ Rent Assistance juak. Ji ŋäc ŋɔak ti ŋuan ci̱ Centrelink yɔ̈k, kɛnɛ ɛmɛ ɛ yiëëu thuɔ̱ɔ̱ŋ.
howItWorks.rank1: Cieŋ diaal ɛ namba kä 100 yɔ̈k kɛ kä ti dhärow: thiäk kɛ yiëëu, thukul kɛnɛ klas Thok Liŋlith, dɔktɔr kɛnɛ duel wal, bus kɛnɛ train, nath thok, cieŋ nath kɛnɛ kä rac ca ke lar.
howItWorks.rank2: Ji kuɛny kä diit di̱ kä kɛl diaal. Thiäk kɛ yiëëu ɛ diit diaal, kɛnɛ kä rac ca ke lar ɛ tuɔk kɛ Ci̱ diit.
howItWorks.rank3: Thiäk kɛ yiëëu ɛ wä piny kuɔ̱ɔ̱th mi rent wä kä 30% yiëëu. Mi lɔ̈ɔ̈ di flat ka house, cieŋ diaal ɛ kä ti rent tot la̱t. Mi thilɛ Rental Report namba kɛ cieŋ, kɔn la̱t kɛ median council ka cieŋ ti thiäk, kɛnɛ kɔn gɔ̈r mi rent ɛ kä ca jɛ kuen.
howItWorks.rank4: Cieŋ ti tɛ̈ kä yiëëu du ɛ nhiam, kɛnɛ cieŋ ti rent kä thuk 35% yiëëu ɛ ciëën. Cieŋ kɔ̈k diaal ɛ ŋuɔt tɛ̈ ciëën, kɛ Diit kä yiëëu du ka Thilɛ namba rent ɛmɔ. Nath thok du ɛ guir gɛ̈r kɛnɛ ci̱ cieŋ kuɛ̈k.
howItWorks.coverage1: New Roots ɛ cieŋ Melbourne in Diit nyuth kɛ rɔ. Thilɛ cieŋ ti mec kä Victoria ka state kɔ̈k ɛmɔ.
howItWorks.coverage2: Ɛ cieŋ ti gɔa ba ke gɔr nyuth, ci̱ duɔɔl rent. Mi ca di cieŋ kuɛny, ɛ ŋuɔt gɔr ba duɔɔl gɔr kɛnɛ application la̱t.

accessibility.title: Luäk nɛn kɛnɛ liŋ
accessibility.lead: New Roots ca jɛ la̱t ba Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 level AA yɔ̈k, ba la̱t kä telepun, keyboard ka screen reader.
accessibility.contrast: Kuɛny Kä ca jɛ guir kɛ kuɛɛr New Roots, Car kɛ wël bor kä car, ka Bor kɛnɛ car diit kɛ wël car kä bor kɛ links blue kɛnɛ kuɛɛr car kä kä diaal. Bor kɛnɛ car diit ɛ AAA yɔ̈k, kɛnɛ ɛ liep rɔ mi ca telepun du guir kɛ contrast diit.
accessibility.mapContrast: Map tɛ̈ kɛ Bor kɛnɛ car diit kɛ rɔ, ti map gɛ̈r kɛ rɔ. Cieŋ ɛ wä kä bor, yellow, teal kɛnɛ blue kä thuk car mi thiäk kuɔ̱ɔ̱th. Kuɛɛr diaal ɛ car kɛ bor kä kɔ̈ɔ̈th rɛw, ba nɛn kɛ 5:1 ka ŋuan kä kuɛɛr diaal.
accessibility.done1: Wël tɛ̈ kɛ contrast 4.5 kä 1 ka ŋuan, kɛnɛ button, field kɛnɛ focus outline ɛ 3 kä 1 ka ŋuan.
accessibility.done2: Button diaal kɛnɛ option ɛ 48 pixels ka ŋuan, rɛw kä kä gɔr WCAG 2.2.
accessibility.done3: Wël ɛ 16 pixels, gɔ̈r kä field ɛ 18, kɛnɛ wël ti ci̱ tɛ̈ kä map ci̱ tot kä 14.
accessibility.done4: Kuɛɛr ci̱ wël lar kɛ rɔ. Budget labels ɛ icon kɛnɛ wël, kɛnɛ list tɛ̈ kɛ cieŋ diaal kɛnɛ namba ti nyuth map.
accessibility.done5: Kä diaal ɛ la̱t kɛ keyboard, kɛnɛ screen reader ɛ lar mi gɛ̈r gɔ̈ɔ̈r ka kä.
accessibility.done6: Gɔ̈ɔ̈r ɛ thiäk kä screen 320 pixels kɛ thilɛ scroll kɔ̈ɔ̈th, kɛnɛ ɛ ŋuɔt la̱t mi ca wël la̱t rɛw ti diit.
accessibility.tested: Mi ŋuɔt kɔn kä pay nyuth, kɔn nɛn gɔ̈ɔ̈r diaal kɛ kompiuta kɛnɛ kɔn thɛm contrast kuɛɛr diaal. Kɔn ca nɛn kä November 2026.
accessibility.limit1: Kuɛɛr ti thiäk kä map lɔ̈ɔ̈ ke ci̱ ŋäc gɔa. Liep Bor kɛnɛ car diit map, ka la̱t kɛ list, ti tɛ̈ kɛ cieŋ kɛnɛ namba kɛ ɛmɛ.
accessibility.limit2: Wël kä map ɛ tot mi map ɛ mec. Wä thiäk, ka kuɛny cieŋ kä list piny map.
accessibility.limit3: Thuk ti ci̱ Thok Liŋlith ca ke wɛ̈r kɛ kompiuta, kɛnɛ wël kɔ̈k lɔ̈ɔ̈ ke ci̱ thuɔ̱ɔ̱ŋ. Kɛ ran in wɛ̈r wël, cɔl TIS National kɛ 131 450.
accessibility.helpHeading: Gɔr luäk ba New Roots la̱t?
accessibility.help: Settlement worker ka caseworker lɔ̈ɔ̈ New Roots nɛn kɛ ji, kɛnɛ TIS National ɛ wël wɛ̈r kɛ thilɛ yiëëu kä telepun ti ŋuan.
